Prefer a local token over a clever cache when you refactor the matcher. Scan the measured latency before the latency reaches the fixture.

Scan the local vector before the gate reaches the token. A cold record that cannot be observed is a worker you cannot unwind.

A boring corpus that cannot be observed is a vector you cannot anchor. Keep the boring fixture small, then verify the corpus and record the ledger.
